en.topic_title: Man arrested over hidden pinhole cameras in Sha Tin gym changing room

zh.topic_title: Man arrested over hidden pinhole cameras in Sha Tin gym changing room

en.topic_title: Man arrested over hidden pinhole cameras in Sha Tin gym changing room
en.topic_summary:
Police have arrested a Hong Kong man on suspicion of installing hidden pinhole cameras in a commercial gym’s changing room.





Police officers at a 24/7 Fitness Shatin Photo: Threads.





A pinhole camera found at a 24/7 Fitness Shatin. Photo: @4_matthew_15 via Threads screenshot.





The 34-year-old suspect, surnamed Fung, was arrested on Sunday after a staff member at 24/7 Fitness Shatin in Lek Yuen Estate noticed the cameras and filed a police report, according to a police brief.
